mr_title: Fix producer callback handling when partition is missing
mr_description:
Sometimes, the Kafka producer encounters an error prior to selecting a topic partition. In this case, we
would like to acknowledge the failure in the producer interceptors, if any are configured. We should also
pass a non-null Metadata object to the producer callback, if there is one. This PR implements that
behavior. It also updates the JavaDoc to clarify that if a partition cannot be selected, we will pass
back a partition id of -1 in the metadata. This is in keeping with KAFKA-3303.

Co-authors: Kirk True <kirk@mustardgrain.com>

expected_issues.title: Interceptors acknowledged twice for a failed send
expected_issues.description:
On a send error the new InterceptorCallback already calls interceptors.onAcknowledgement(), and the unchanged interceptors.onSendError() a few lines below calls it again, so interceptors are notified twice for the same failed record.

ProducerInterceptors.onSendError() invokes onAcknowledgement() for each interceptor. Wrapping the user callback in InterceptorCallback and completing it here triggers a first onAcknowledgement() before onSendError() triggers a second one. Interceptors that count or audit acknowledgements (metrics, tracing, exactly-once bookkeeping) double-count failures. Only the user callback should be completed here.
